title: 第331章 信仰第330章 红葡萄镇
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
莉亚点点头，便习惯性地开始为沃尔讲解吸血鬼的怪物知识：
“吸血鬼的源头，是吸血鬼主神、鲜血与血魔法之神，深渊第487层领主，坎切尔希斯，所以吸血鬼的力量和诅咒都来源于祂……”
据莉亚讲述，这个世界最古老的吸血鬼，都是被这位神祇在被秩序诸神击败后泼洒的血液所感染，以及地狱魔鬼的吸血鬼契约所转化。
这些嗜血的怪物一度在大地上建立可怕的吸血鬼王朝，但都被人类领主和秩序诸神的牧师所消灭，自彼得皇帝统治帝国以来，已经没怎么听说过大规模的吸血鬼袭击事件了。
听完莉亚的讲述，沃尔有些奇怪道：“莉亚，你似乎对这位吸血鬼主神很熟悉啊，祂有什么特别的地方吗？”
莉亚点点头，侧头凑近沃尔耳边，用严肃的语气小声道：“我小时候阅读过部落的圣典，上面记载了一些上古精灵诸神的故事，其中，就有这位吸血鬼主神的记载，这位主神的诞生，隐藏着诸神的一些秘辛。”
沃尔顿时来了兴趣，他明白莉亚的顾虑，光明正大蛐蛐诸神可不是一个理智的举动，随即便发动心灵感应，在两人的心灵间建立一道无法被窃取的临时灵能链接。
在心灵感应中，沃尔很快得知了莉亚所知的秘辛，吸血鬼之神的诞生，还在精灵和人类种族诞生之前，是创世纪初期，诸神用神血进行的一次尝试性造物的产物。
这个造物汇聚了诸神的美丽、智慧和永生本质，也汇聚了他们的贪婪和掠夺本性，并且，其生来便拥有反抗创造者的本能，所以，诸神才试图将其毁灭。
而在地狱和深渊的干扰下，吸血鬼之神坎切尔希斯并没有被彻底抹除，在经过一番利益交换后，还成为了深渊的领主之一，在诸神创造出精灵之类的凡人种族后，吸血鬼之神也创造出属于自己的眷属。
不过为了避免如同自己背叛诸神一般背叛自己，他给眷属下了可怕的诅咒以限制他们的力量，首先，吸血鬼必须依赖鲜活智慧生物的血液才能生存，长期不饮用鲜血，会退化成无智的野兽。
其次，它们畏惧阳光等秩序力量，甚至无法跨过纯洁的流水，再生能力会被金属银阻止，心脏被木刺贯穿，即使是号称不死之身的传奇吸血鬼，也会被封印全部力量，陷入沉睡。
相应的，吸血鬼也非常强大，真正的吸血鬼几乎不会自然死亡，实力强大，战斗力至少是大师阶职业者的水准，再生能力堪比巨魔，还拥有血魔法，制造吸血鬼衍体，召唤野兽奴仆，变身、飞行、魅惑等能力，非常可怕。
相间那种半夜才墓地里爬出，智力低下，只会鬼叫和吸血的吸血鬼，都是吸血鬼制造的衍体而已，但即使是吸血鬼衍体，也有堪比正式职业者的实力。
一支四个职业者组成的赤铜级冒险团，毫无准备的情况下在野外与吸血鬼衍体遭遇，也有团灭的风险。
听完莉亚的讲述后，沃尔很快对吸血鬼这种怪物有了足够深刻的了解，对付它们，必须要用克制的手段，硬碰硬会很吃亏。
两人一边聊着，一边回到营地，门边站岗的士兵老远便露出笑脸打招呼，为两人开门让行。
屋内一片喧闹，十来个穿着铠甲的大汉撅着屁股围着一张长桌哄闹着，似乎在讨论什么口号和印记之类的东西。
“兄弟们，干什么呢，让我也瞅瞅！”沃尔笑着一掌拍在撅得最高的腚上，士兵们顿时散开，露出里面一手拿书，一手握笔的霍恩，桌子上还有不少草图，沃尔晃眼一看，除了各种图案，还有口号。
这些图案中，有一半都是刀剑、枪斧、盾牌之类的武器，还有一半则是抽象的骷髅图案，而口号中，有：

〖战旗！战旗！战无不胜！〗
〖为了战旗冒险团的荣耀！冲锋！！〗
〖血祭战旗！颅献团长！〗
……
“这都什么乱七八糟的……”沃尔有些无语，霍恩憨笑着摸了摸脑袋上的牛角，有些不好意思道：
“团长，我们正在给冒险团想口号和宣言呢，我发现在战斗的时候，总得喊点什么才更有气势，能让兄弟们发挥得更好，不过各喊各的也不行，所以才……”
见沃尔并没有生气，战士们也都没有再紧张，屁股被拍了一下的战士揉着屁股笑道：“团长，您看，有没有合适的，我们多研究研究。”
有个统一的口号确实不错，沃尔便坐了下来，开始和战士们研究起来。
一旁的莉亚见沃尔和战士们融洽地样子勾起嘴角，眼眸中露出一抹温柔，转身向着楼上房间走去，准备开始自己的学习和研究。
这时，角落中趴着的青狼站起身摇了摇头，看了看沃尔，又看了看楼梯的方向，便迈着有力的步伐小跑着跟上莉亚而去。
这时，沃尔也了解到了战士们的想法，这些家伙并不算简单的想要给冒险团想个口号，而是想要按照圣提尔教廷的罚罪骑士团那样，把战旗冒险团搞成一个信仰坚定的教团！
至于信仰的神祇，自然就是勇气与战争之神，一个士兵绷着脸说道：“团长大人，您知道的，我其实一直对您，哦，是勇气与战争之神非常虔诚！为祂战死，进入祂的国，是我最大的荣幸！”
其他士兵也纷纷点头，一脸狂热的样子，沃尔差点有些绷不住表情，现在哪有勇气与战争之神啊，这些家伙就算战死，也进不去什么神国，最多被他收进自己的魂幡，哦不，是神器战旗之中。
不过沃尔也确实能感受到这些战士火热的信仰，虽然其中掺杂着私欲和野心，但并不虚假，神祇战旗内加快凝聚的头颅便是证明。
沃尔有些犹豫，传播信仰对自己是很有好处的，但也会增加被盯上的风险，不过，他转念一想，这个世界神祇众多，信仰繁杂，勇气与战争之神也不是什么邪神的化身，自己行得端坐得正，现在也小有实力，并不怕查水表。
至于自己会不会被冠以渎神的罪名，只要自己不自称为神，也混入信徒中不就行了。
想通之后，沃尔面容一肃，轻咳一声道：“好吧，其实，我也是勇气与战争之神的忠诚信徒来着……”

content_en:
Leah nodded, and habitually began to explain vampire monster knowledge to Wall:
"The source of vampires is the main god of vampires, the god of blood and blood magic, the lord of the 487th layer of the abyss, Canchelsis, so the power and curse of vampires come from him..."
According to Leah, the oldest vampires in the world were infected by the blood spilled by this god after being defeated by the gods of order, and transformed by the vampire contract of the devil in hell.
These bloodthirsty monsters once established a terrifying vampire dynasty on the earth, but they were all eliminated by human lords and priests of the gods of order. Since Emperor Peter ruled the empire, there have been few large-scale vampire attacks heard of.
After listening to Leah's story, Wall said strangely: "Lia, you seem to be very familiar with this vampire god. Is there anything special about him?"
Leah nodded, tilted her head close to Wall's ear, and whispered in a serious tone: "When I was a child, I read the tribe's holy book, which recorded some stories of the ancient elves and gods. Among them, there is a record of the vampire god. The birth of this god hides some secrets of the gods."
Walton suddenly became interested. He understood Leah's concerns. It was not a rational move for the Cricket Gods to act openly and honestly. Then he activated his telepathy and established a temporary spiritual link between the two minds that could not be stolen.
Through telepathy, Wall quickly learned the secrets that Leah knew. The birth of the vampire god was the product of an experimental creation by the gods using divine blood in the early days of creation, before the birth of the elves and human races.
This creation brought together the beauty, wisdom and immortal essence of the gods, as well as their greed and predatory nature. Moreover, it was born with the instinct to resist the creator, so the gods tried to destroy it.
Under the interference of hell and the abyss, the vampire god Canchelis was not completely eradicated. After some exchange of interests, he became one of the lords of the abyss. After the gods created mortal races such as elves, the vampire god also created his own dependents.
However, in order to avoid betraying himself as he betrayed the gods, he placed a terrible curse on his followers to limit their power. First of all, vampires must rely on the blood of living intelligent creatures to survive. If they do not drink blood for a long time, they will degenerate into mindless beasts.
Secondly, they are afraid of the power of order such as sunlight, and cannot even cross pure running water. Their regeneration ability will be blocked by metallic silver, and their hearts will be pierced by wooden thorns. Even legendary vampires known as immortals will have all their power sealed and fall into a deep sleep.
Correspondingly, vampires are also very powerful. Real vampires almost never die naturally. They are powerful, and their combat effectiveness is at least as good as that of a master-level professional. Their regeneration ability is comparable to that of a troll. They also possess blood magic, create vampire spawn, summon beast slaves, transform, fly, charm and other abilities, which are very terrifying.
Vampires like Soma who crawl out of the cemetery in the middle of the night, have low intelligence, and can only scream and suck blood are just spawns made by vampires, but even vampire spawns have strength comparable to formal professionals.
A copper-level adventure group composed of four professionals encountered a vampire spawn in the wild without any preparation, and there was also a risk of the group being destroyed.
After listening to Leah's story, Wall quickly gained a deep enough understanding of monsters like vampires. To deal with them, you must use restraint. If you confront them head-on, you will suffer a lot.
While the two were chatting, they returned to the camp. The soldier standing guard at the door greeted them with a smile and opened the door for them to pass.
There was a lot of noise in the room, with a dozen big men in armor sticking their butts out and making noise around a long table, seeming to be discussing slogans and imprints.
"Brothers, what are you doing? Let meTake a look too! "Wall smiled and slapped the highest-protruding buttocks with his palm. The soldiers immediately dispersed, revealing Horn holding a book in one hand and a pen in the other. There were many sketches on the table. Wall glanced and saw that in addition to various patterns, there were also slogans.
Half of these patterns are weapons such as swords, spears, axes, and shields, and the other half are abstract skull patterns. Among the slogans are:
〖Battle flag! Battle flag! Invincible! 〗
〖For the glory of the Battle Flag Adventure Group! Charge! ! 〗
〖Blood Sacrifice Battle Flag! Head of the group! 〗
…
"This is all such a mess..." Wall was speechless. Horn smiled and touched the horns on his head, and said a little embarrassedly:
"Captain, we are thinking of slogans and declarations for the adventure group. I found that during the battle, you have to shout something to be more powerful and allow the brothers to perform better. However, it doesn't work if everyone shouts their own thing, so..."
Seeing that Wall was not angry, and the soldiers were no longer nervous, the soldier who was slapped on the butt rubbed his butt and said with a smile: "Commander, look, if there is anything suitable, let's do more research. "
It was really good to have a unified slogan, so Wall sat down and began to study it with the soldiers.
Leah on the side raised her lips when she saw the harmonious appearance of Wall and the soldiers, with a touch of tenderness in her eyes. She turned and walked towards the room upstairs, ready to start her own study and research.
At this time, the green wolf lying in the corner stood up and shook his head, looked at Wall, then looked at the direction of the stairs, then trotted to follow Leah with strong steps.
At this time, Wall also understood the thoughts of the soldiers. These guys did not simply want to come up with a slogan for the adventure group, but wanted to turn the Flag Adventure Group into a religious order with firm beliefs like the Punishment Knights of the Holy See of Saint Tyr!
As for the god of faith, he is naturally the God of Courage and War. A soldier said with a sullen face: "Master Captain, you know, I have always been very devoted to you, oh, the God of Courage and War! It is my greatest honor to die fighting for Him and enter His kingdom! "
The other soldiers also nodded, with enthusiastic expressions on their faces. Wall almost lost his expression. How could he have the courage and the God of War now? Even if these guys died in battle, they would not be able to enter the kingdom of God. At most, they would be collected by him into his own soul flag, oh no, it was the artifact battle flag.
However, Wall can indeed feel the fiery faith of these warriors. Although it is mixed with selfish desires and ambitions, it is not false. The heads that gather faster in the battle flag of the gods are proof.
Wall was a little hesitant. Spreading his faith would be very beneficial to him, but it would also increase the risk of being targeted. However, he then thought about it. There are many gods in this world and the beliefs are complex. The God of Courage and War is not the incarnation of an evil god. He behaves upright and has some strength now, so he is not afraid of checking the water meter.
As for whether he will be accused of blasphemy, it will be fine as long as he does not claim to be God and blends in among believers.
After thinking about it, Wall looked solemn, coughed slightly and said: "Okay, actually, I am also a loyal believer in the God of Courage and War..."
